recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-15022 unless a future work group decision reintroduces Media as an active resource, in which case that future decision should define its classification.
issue_request: FHIR-15022 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 change request asking to move Media from Foundation/Other and FHIR-I/infrastructure ownership to O&O/clinical classification on the Resource Type Index.
initial_application: Jira comments said the issue was already pre-applied. Git history confirms commit e5b3d89ec3d202f6f979c0e55dbe6678b4bf5c45 moved Media from Foundation/Other into Clinical Diagnostics in source/resourcelist.html and changed fhir.ini from media=fhir to media=oo before the issue was created.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini has no active media=Media entry in [resources], and current source/resourcelist.html has no Media entry in either Foundation/Other or Clinical Diagnostics. Later GF#19250/FHIR-19250 history, including commit 5c62f91cd81f150be72ad506c876e3cc20bd631d, removed Media from active resources and replaced the Clinical Diagnostics resource-list slot with DocumentReference. FHIR-19250 is already represented on the combined reconciliation branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The requested STU3 resource-list move was already applied, and the current build has no Media resource to misclassify.

related_jiras.note: Later DocumentReference boundary work removed Media from active resources and explains why the current Resource Type Index has no Media entry; it is already represented on the combined branch.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive STU3 request to reclassify Media from Foundation/Other to O&O/clinical on the Resource Type Index, with comments saying it was already pre-applied.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final requested change and that Jira itself expected no further application work at resolution time.

evidence_items.summary: Pre-issue commit moved Media out of Foundation/Other into Clinical Diagnostics in source/resourcelist.html and changed fhir.ini media=fhir to media=oo.
evidence_items.learned: The requested classification change was applied before FHIR-15022 was created.

evidence_items.summary: The current Resource Type Index includes Foundation/Other and Clinical Diagnostics sections but no Media entry; active [resources] in fhir.ini has no media=Media entry.
evidence_items.learned: The current build has no active Media resource to classify, so it cannot still be incorrectly listed under Foundation/Other.

evidence_items.summary: GF#19250 Media-to-DocumentReference commit removed media=Media from active resources and replaced the Clinical Diagnostics Media list entry with DocumentReference.
evidence_items.learned: Later source history explains why the current Resource Type Index correctly has no Media entry.
